text:
maya: FYI — planning to bind Vault/staging transit to the HSM-backed KMS key (projects/infra/keys/vault-hsm). Goal: replace softwrapped key and enforce request-level conditions in the IAM policy. Doing a short maintenance window tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need RBAC preflight, audit retention confirmation, and CI pipeline secret checks.

sam: thanks. what IAM condition are we planning to add?

maya: something like: `condition: request.auth.aud == 'vault' && request.auth.principalEmail.endsWith('@redwood.internal')` so only vault service identities can use the key. also we want logs to include keyVersion and callerPrincipal.

leo: strong 👍. can we also require ctlog-like attestations from the KMS for cross-project callers? partner-sync is in a different project and we should avoid direct key grants.

maya: partner-sync will not get the key. plan is to provision short-lived envelope tokens for partner-sync via a constrained Vault role.

ana: audit question — our fluentd→splunk pipeline had a retention TTL on staging events of 14d. the k8s audit sink uses GCS. during rotation we should switch to durable S3 backup to avoid TTL pruning. i'll set up the buffer.

sec-bot: KMS health check: all keys in project infra OK. Notifying oncall.

oncall: I'm awake. what's the exact blast-radius reduction here?

maya: HSM key limits cross-project grants, enforces conditions, and we can disable without destroying secrets. rollbacks are faster.

sam: preflight checks I ran:
- `kubectl auth can-i update secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:platform:vault-agent-stg` => yes
- `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy vault-hsm --project=infra` => current bindings: admin group + cryptoServiceAccount
I'll prepare the conditional binding and share the terraform snippet.

leo: please also add an OPA policy to prevent non-vault SAs from creating transit keys or keywrap roles. we had a CI PR last month that accidentally granted broad create rights.

maya: noted. also discovered during inventory: one CI job in repo infra-ci had a plaintext test key in env.test. I'll open a rotate/expunge ticket for that secret.

ana: buffer ready. I'll keep audit-forwarder in passive mode during the window and upload the buffer afterwards. will record SHA256 checksums.

sam: terraform snippet (will PR):
```hcl
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "vaultwrap" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/vault/cryptoKeys/vault-hsm"
  role          = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter"
  members       = ["serviceAccount:vault-agent-stg@infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
  condition {
    title       = "vault-only"
    description = "Only Vault SA can use key"
    expression  = "request.auth.principal_email.endsWith('@redwood.internal')"
  }
}
```

leo: lgtm but change expression to `request.auth.principal_email.endsWith('@redwood.internal') && request.time < timestamp('2026-04-01T00:00:00Z')` for a short TTL so we can test auto-expiry.

maya: good call, will add temporary TTL and remove after verification.

sec-bot: created incident INC-2026-0501-kms-hsm-rollout (https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0501). attaching audit buffer link.

ana: during canary I'll watch for these audit events: `google.kms.cryptoKeyVersion.use`, `google.kms.cryptoKeyVersion.encrypt`, `google.kms.cryptoKeyVersion.decrypt`. send me timestamps in thread.

maya: canary started. vault-agent-stg successfully used the HSM key to wrap a small payload. sample event id: evt_20260401_090112.

sam: terraform apply done for canary binding.

leo: ran OPA test locally. partner-sync fails as expected: `cannot create: RBAC deny rule`

maya: noticing one anomaly — audit shows a blank principal for a decrypt event at 09:01:15. ana, did buffer experience any reformatting?

ana: checking buffer. looks like one event trimmed due to malformed JSON from legacy fluentd plugin. i pulled the raw and rehydrated; I'll post the SHA256 and attach the corrected event to the incident.

sec-bot: alert: infra-ci job #882 reported env leak. maya, do you want immediate rotation?

maya: yes. rotate the impacted key material and revoke any tokens created by that job. sam, coordinate CI secret rotation and ensure build history is scrubbed.

sam: acknowledged. creating CICD ticket and rotating. will post rotation time and new service token fingerprint.

leo: followup: add an IAM deny at org level to prevent future infra-ci service accounts from getting kms roles without an approval ticket. i'll draft a policy.

maya: rollback plan if something breaks: 1) remove condition (revert to previous binding), 2) rebind old softwrap key in vault transit, 3) restore audit-forwarder endpoint, 4) revoke canary tokens.

ana: buffer uploaded to long-term store at s3://redwood-audit-archive/staging/3850012345/, SHA256: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855 (attached to INC).

maya: canary stable for 10m, no decrypt errors, audit events present with principals. scheduling partner-sync mitigation workshop next week. thanks all :thumbsup:
